entries.wording: The electronic information of the goods has been received
entries.note: The platform's order row: the shipment's data received, before LingXun has the parcel.

entries.wording: The package has arrived at the processing center
entries.note: The first scan in LingXun's hands, at its processing station in China, with the platform's receipt code.

entries.wording: The parcel arrived at the processing center
entries.note: A custom track row the line writes ahead for Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Australia; the reader holds it back as planned.

entries.wording: The parcel depart the processing center
entries.note: A custom track row the line writes ahead for Shenzhen; held back as planned.
A custom track row the line writes ahead for Hong Kong's export clearance; held back as planned. Cleared, so the parcel moves on.

entries.wording: The flight has taken off from its origin
entries.note: A custom track row the line writes ahead for the flight from Hong Kong; held back as planned.
The landing in Australia, copied from the delivery network, as DAI Post words its DA01 scan.
Collected in Brisbane the morning after the landing, a minute before clearance; the parcel is still on its way.
Australian customs released the parcel, as DAI Post words its DC01 scan.
Sorted at the delivery network's Brisbane facility after clearance.

entries.wording: Parcel out for final mile carrier delivery
entries.note: Out for delivery in the recipient's town, as DAI Post words its FP05 scan; the delivery follows within the hour.
Left at the address with the recipient's authority, as DAI Post words its FD02 scan.
